name: GX470 factory + clamp, Toyota 90982-05054 (estimate)

mounts.note: origin = post axis at the clamp bottom (adapter base top); pinch-bolt ears at -X

notes: ESTIMATE from memory of the part, not dimensioned: Toyota 90982-05054 (GX470/4Runner positive battery clamp) is a stamped clamp with a pinch bolt and a side tab carrying a small threaded stud (assumed M8). Ring end (thin stub) and thick cable ring on that stud, flat strap stub rising from the clamp. All sizes (ring ID = SAE + post bottom 18.5 mm, wall 0.07, height 0.55, tab, strap 0.7 x 1.0 in) are guesses; measure the real one.
